title: Transabdominal Chest Drains to Reduce Postoperative Pain Following Minimally Invasive Esophagectomy - DISCUSS-Trial
summary: Die DISCUSS-Studie soll untersuchen, ob nach dem Ösophagus Resektion auf die transthorakale Ausleitung von Drainageschläuchen verzichtet werden kann und dadurch nachhaltig die Schmerzen der Patienten reduziert werden können.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm: Lower third of oesophagus

interventions.name: Transabdominal chest drainage after Iwor-Lewis in prospective recruited patients
Intercostal chest drainage after Iwor-Lewis from a historical cohort

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
•	elective RAMIE with intrathoracic esophagogastrostomy (Ivor-Lewis) 
•	American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) score ≤ III
•	Eastern Cooperative of Oncology Group (ECOG) status ≤ II
•	patient suitable for both surgical techniques
•	ability of subject to understand character and individual consequences of the clinical trial 
•	written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
emergency surgery, ASA IV, ECOG > II, chronic pain syndromes requiring routine analgesic therapy, participation in an interventional trial that affects the outcome, and impaired mental state that precludes admission
